//Categories: A-6: a fixed enumeration, not a user-managed taxonomy. A-14: every category maps to exactly
one department, and a ticket takes its departmentId from this map at creation. An unmapped or
dangling DepartmentId is a STARTUP FAILURE naming the category (ConfigurationValidator).
DepartmentId values are OrganizationSeeder's deterministic ids (Story 03).
//Priorities: A-6 fixes these four levels. This section exists so the values have one home, NOT so they can
be changed: startup validation rejects a fifth level, a rename, or a reorder.
//Sla: A-3: a 24/7 clock measured from ticket creation. No business hours, no holiday calendar, no
per-branch timezone, no pause on customer reply - product-scope section 9 item 5 keeps all of
that open. Every priority must appear, with both hour values greater than zero.
//QuickReplies: T1-C: the agent canned-response library. Staff-only (AP-17, B-2) - never returned to a
Customer. May legitimately be empty; a malformed entry is a startup failure.

Items.Title: Acknowledge
Items.Body: Thank you for getting in touch. We have received your request and are looking into it.

Items.Title: Request more information
Items.Body: To help us investigate, could you please provide a little more detail about what you were doing when this happened?

Items.Title: Confirm resolution
Items.Body: We believe this is now resolved. Please let us know if you are still seeing the problem.

//Registration: A-15: a self-registering customer is assigned the system default branch and is not asked to
choose one. The request cannot override it. Must reference an existing branch - checked at
startup. This is OrganizationSeeder's Head Office id (Story 03).
//Attachments: T2-A. No approved document fixes this number; it is configuration so it is visible and
changeable without a code change. 10 MiB. An upload above it is 413 attachment-too-large.
StorageRoot is Story 04's one added key: local disk by design (architecture 4.4). A relative
value resolves against the content root, so this default works on a dev machine and in the
test host; Compose overrides it with an absolute path on a mounted volume. Never returned to
a client - neither this nor Attachment.storagePath appears in any response (api-design 6.7).
//Feedback: *** OQ-1 IS OPEN. THESE VALUES ARE A PLACEHOLDER, NOT A DECISION. ***
architecture.md 6.3: 'The boundary values are deliberately not decided here - OQ-1 is open.
The key exists so the contract has a home for the answer; inventing the answer is out of
scope.' api-design.md 6.9 calls the values it shows 'illustrative placeholders, not a
decision.' Startup validation checks only Min < Max and asserts nothing about which values are
correct. Story 13 renders the control from these values - an ordinal range is a rating scale, a
binary scale is two buttons - so ANSWERING OQ-1 IS AN EDIT HERE, not a code change. No min or
max constant appears anywhere else in the codebase.
